summary_1line: Messengers summon Bharata urgently to Ayodhya; after questioning them and receiving gifts from his grandfather and uncle, he departs with Shatrughna.

image_candidates.scene_text: Exhausted royal messengers arrive at the fortified city of Rajagriha and bow before Prince Bharata with Vasistha’s urgent message.
King Kaikeya embraces Bharata, smelling his head in blessing while attendants display elephants, horses, and heaps of ornaments as farewell gifts.
Bharata and Shatrughna mount a chariot amid elephants, horses, and soldiers as their grand procession departs the palace gates.
